This is a **high-severity water damage** claim for [Okafor Household](/lightning/r/001aj000040t1ntAAA/view) under [ANT-HO-204585](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKc7NAAS/view). It's still **Under Investigation**. The policy was in force on the date of loss, and coverage is confirmed with a **$2,500** deductible.

- **Loss:** On 21 Sep a braided supply line failed at its fitting while the family was away. Water damaged the flooring, the drywall up to four feet, the furnace and stored belongings at 2620 Central Park Ave, Evanston. It was reported 22 Sep.
- **Money:** Estimated loss is **$48,500**, the reserve is **$45,000**, **$5,000** has been paid as an advance and **$40,000** of the reserve is still outstanding.
- **Latest (30 Sep):** Drying is done and moisture readings are normal. The adjuster is waiting on the mitigation invoice and the rebuild estimate.
- No referral to the fraud unit and no chance of recovering costs from someone else.

The estimated loss is **$3,500** higher than the reserve, so check the reserve when the rebuild estimate comes in.
